dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Bank is at risk due to behavioral reasons. While in care, Bank has been observed to be fearful. Noted to balk and retreat from the kennel while on leash. He has needed a sling to be returned to kennel. Bank has also been observed to be highly stressed while in kennel. Noted to rub his nose on the kennel bars and bite the kennel bars. Bank's previous owner describes him as friendly and playful. While out with handlers, Bank has a neutral body and is receptive to the cue sit. Medically, Bank has CIRDC.

Bank arrived at MACC as an owner surrender. His previous owner describes him as a friendly and playful dog. While in care, Bank has been observed to be highly fearful. Noted to balk and pancake while on leash. He has needed a sling to be returned to kennel. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult-only home.
dog.name: Bank
